title: Fix Import Meta Glob Undefined In Cad Vitest Suites
description: cad/* module vitest suites (and cad/runtime) print `[DEBUG] typeof import.meta.glob: undefined` from cad/runtime/js/index.ts, causing shippedModelDefinitionAssets() to fall back to emptyModelDefinitionAssets() and every stat/property/typology lookup to null-deref. Root cause: cad/* package.json files (plus infinite/world/r3f, kernel/3d/brep/js) pin "vitest": "^3.2.4" while the rest of the monorepo is on "^4.0.17"/4.1.7, so bun installs a separate nested vitest@3.2.4 (with its own older vite) for these packages instead of hoisting the shared 4.x. That older vitest/vite combo fails to statically transform import.meta.glob under these packages' multi-root aliased vitest configs. Fix: bump vitest to match the rest of the repo in all affected package.json files, reinstall, verify all affected suites pass, then remove the [DEBUG] console.log lines in cad/runtime/js/index.ts.
summary: Root-caused `import.meta.glob` resolving to `undefined` in cad/* vitest suites (cad/runtime/js/index.ts shippedModelDefinitionAssets falling back to empty catalogs, breaking loadStatDefinition/objectsForStatCompute everywhere). Cause: every cad/* package (plus infinite/world/r3f, kernel/3d/brep/js) pinned "vitest": "^3.2.4" in its own package.json while the rest of the monorepo had moved to "^4.0.17", so bun installed a separate nested vitest@3.2.4 (with its own older vite) for these packages instead of hoisting the shared 4.x — that older vite failed to statically transform import.meta.glob under these packages' multi-root aliased vitest configs. Bumped all 12 affected package.json files to "^4.0.17" to match the rest of the repo, reinstalled with bun (now hoists a single vitest@4.1.7, no nested copies), and verified with vitest 3.2.4 reinstalled temporarily as a control that two other failures (cad/core interaction e2e fixtures, cad/kernel/brepjs concrete-forest fixture) are pre-existing bugs unmasked by real catalogs loading, not caused by this version bump or this fix. Removed the two [DEBUG] console.log lines from cad/runtime/js/index.ts (import.meta.glob typeof check, bootstrapCadModules). All previously-broken cad/* and cad/runtime suites now pass; ran the full affected-package sweep twice to confirm.
